failures.pattern: [38;2;74;222;128m[1m✓[0m reveal shows 1/3 pass count on failure
failures.root_cause: sw-intent-analysis-test asserts analyze_intent's JSON output includes version, goal, and criteria fields, but the current schema/implementation omits one or more of them
failures.fix: Update analyze_intent (or its schema) in sw-intent-analysis.sh to emit version, goal, and criteria fields matching the test's expected schema

failures.pattern: [2m  loop behavior: iterations on test failure[0m
failures.root_cause: sw-pipeline-test.sh: plan stage never writes .claude/pipeline-artifacts/plan.md, cascading to review/E2E/resume/cleanup failures, plus a jq parse error on a non-numeric complexity value in the RL/intelligence test
failures.fix: Fix the plan stage mock/handler to emit plan.md (and dod.md) before downstream stages run, and quote/validate the complexity value before piping it to jq

failures.root_cause: sw-cost-test.sh expects CONTEXT EFFICIENCY section populated from loop.context_efficiency events, but cost dashboard reports 'No cost entries in the last 30 day(s)' because the test's seeded events aren't being read/aggregated by the dashboard
failures.fix: Verify sw-cost.sh reads loop.context_efficiency events from the correct events.jsonl path/timeframe used by the test fixture, and that seeded test entries fall within the 30-day window

failures.pattern: [38;2;74;222;128m✓[0m audit_schema_json fails cleanly on a missing schema file
failures.root_cause: sw-intent-analysis-test failed (exit 1); likely an assertion mismatch in intent analysis logic unrelated to the audit_schema_json case cited
failures.fix: Run scripts/sw-intent-analysis-test.sh directly to capture the failing assertion and fix the underlying logic or update the test expectation

failures.root_cause: sw-daemon-test and sw-e2e-integration-test exited non-zero during the run, causing the overall test-all suite to fail
failures.fix: Inspect the failing suites' full output (sw-daemon-test, sw-e2e-integration-test) to identify the specific assertion or mock setup that broke, then fix the underlying code or update the test

failures.root_cause: Cost dashboard's CONTEXT EFFICIENCY section fails to render because no cost entries exist within the 30-day lookback window used by the test fixture
failures.fix: Seed/backdate loop.context_efficiency test fixture entries within the dashboard's 30-day window (or make the window configurable) so sw-cost-test.sh finds matching cost entries
